events: 강재현 possesses the body of an ignored 태림그룹 branch grandson in 1997 during IMF restructuring.
He is assigned to mark telecom-related assets for separate fire sale.
He identifies the failed PCS option, maintenance unit, handset inventory, card billing relationship, and store network as one phone-number and monthly-bill gate.
He uses PCS voting documents and maintenance SLA clauses to win restructuring committee observer seat, 72-hour sale freeze, and limited data-room access.
A base-station failure lets him prove 태림전선 field crews can still produce carrier value, winning procurement direct line and first maintenance order.
He inspects 태림전자 handset warehouse and 태림유통 regional stores, turning dead stock into a regional PCS signup package.
A foreign fund attempts to separate-buy the PCS option while a main-family executive tries to claim the proof.
He uses 태림카드 billing contract to design a phone-bill bundled service-fee pilot and secures billing code, fee-table draft, and legal memo.
He combines maintenance order, handset test, and billing pilot into a 태림모바일서비스 JV proposal.
He receives PCS voting proxy, first settlement fee, and PC communication acquisition review right as the next battlefield ticket.

crisis_candidates: 72-hour fire-sale deadline threatens to scatter the gate assets.
Foreign fund tries to buy the PCS residual option before the bundle is recognized.
Carrier procurement rejects 태림전선 maintenance unit as obsolete.
Base-station outage can either prove maintenance value or humiliate 태림 again.
Handset inventory loses value every week during IMF consumer contraction.
Regional store test can fail if carrier marketing slot is not won.
Billing pilot can be killed by legal risk, consumer complaints, or settlement ambiguity.
Main-family executive may take credit and leave 강재현 with liability.
PC communication acquisition review depends on proving phone-bill settlement first.
Charity-rescue drift can bloat the asset bundle and weaken the gate engine.
scene_details: Committee threshold scene: 강재현 is treated as the branch grandson marking scrap rows before he halts the sale sheet.
Document proof scene: PCS option, maintenance SLA, handset stock, store map, and billing contract are placed on one table as a gate bundle.
Base-station field scene: a closing maintenance team fixes an outage faster than the carrier expects, turning liability into procurement value.
Handset warehouse scene: dead stock becomes a cheap IMF household PCS package when paired with store signup and carrier slot.
Billing contract scene: legal team blocks bundled billing until 강재현 narrows it into pilot code, fee table, and complaint-handling memo.
Foreign fund obstruction scene: separated asset price pressure proves why the sale freeze must hold.
JV table scene: maintenance order, handset test, billing pilot, and PCS voting proxy become 태림모바일서비스.
Next-gate scene: first settlement fee and PC communication acquisition review right open the portal/content battlefield.
notes: Stage 0 material is sufficient for Phase 0. The opening macro battlefield is 태림그룹 IMF telecom scrap sale. The strongest risks are generic platform handwave, charity-rescue drift, too-thin TR blocks, and legality/billing vagueness; these are explicitly locked as constraints.

opening_bundle_contract.bundle_goal: Turn 강재현 from scrap-list branch grandson into the operator who controls PCS voting proxy, maintenance order, handset distribution test, billing pilot, and the next PC communication acquisition gate.
opening_bundle_contract.timing_reconciliation_note: TR 2~6 is the reader-earning opening bundle, not five single episodes. Each block must carry at least two incident beats and same-block receipt. The first next-sector ticket begins at Block 5 through billing pilot code and expands at Block 6 into PC communication acquisition review.
